description: Reply to an existing email identified by folder + uid. Automatically sets the recipient to the original sender, prefixes the subject with "Re:", and preserves threading (In-Reply-To/References). Set replyAll to also include the original recipients. Use this instead of imap_send_email whenever the user is responding to a message already in a mailbox. Account defaultBcc addresses are always BCC'd when configured.

accountId.description: Account ID (from imap_list_accounts). Optional if accountName is given or only one account is configured.

accountName.description: Account name instead of accountId. Optional if accountId is given or only one account is configured.

cid.description: Content-ID for inline attachments. Required when contentDisposition is "inline" and the HTML references the image as . Must match exactly (without the "cid:" prefix or angle brackets).

content.description: Base64 encoded content. Provide exactly one of content or path.

contentDisposition.description: How the attachment is presented. Use "inline" for images referenced from the HTML body via cid: (e.g. a signature/footer banner); omit or use "attachment" for regular downloadable files.

contentType.description: MIME type. When omitted it is detected from the filename extension (e.g. .pdf → application/pdf); unknown extensions fall back to application/octet-stream.

path.description: Readable local file path to attach. Provide exactly one of path or content; paths returned by imap_upload_file are accepted.

bcc.description: BCC recipients. Either an array of addresses or a single comma-separated string; merged with the account defaultBcc when set.

uid.description: UID of the email to reply to

name: imap_reply_to_email
